SELECT TOP 1000
       __$start_lsn as LSN,
       __$operation as Operation,
       __$update_mask as UpdateMask,
       CM03_CUST,
       CM03_NAME,
       CM03_CUSTTYPE,
       CM03_ADD1,
       CM03_CITY,
       CM03_STAT,
       CM03_PZIP,
       CM03_PHON
   FROM @{pipeline().parameters.CDCTableName}
   WHERE __$start_lsn > CONVERT(binary(10), '@{pipeline().parameters.LastProcessedLSN}', 1)
   ORDER BY __$start_lsn

SELECT 
    '@{pipeline().parameters.DatabaseName}' as SOURCE_DATABASE,
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), __$start_lsn, 1) as SOURCE_LSN,
    CASE __$operation
        WHEN 1 THEN 'DELETE'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'INSERT'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'UPDATE_BEFORE'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'UPDATE_AFTER'
    END as CDC_OPERATION,
    CM03_CUST,
    CM03_NAME,
    CM03_CUSTTYPE,
    CM03_ADD1,
    CM03_CITY,
    CM03_STAT,
    CM03_PZIP,
    CM03_PHON
FROM @{pipeline().parameters.CDCTableName}
WHERE __$start_lsn > CONVERT(binary(10), '@{pipeline().parameters.LastProcessedLSN}', 1)
ORDER BY __$start_lsn
